scope: development refinement on the exposed v1 comparison cohort; no fresh policy-generalization claim
context_contract: one world revision/reset and relative coordinate frame; namespaces never pool raw maps across resets
current_observations: part of the active capacity; current perception is explicitly refreshed before recovery
graph_scope: active and explicitly recovered canonical heads only; no all-bank support scan
archive_index: growing in-memory owned numerical snapshot rebuilt after canonical-head changes; all build payloads/time/bytes charged
correction: append new version; exclude superseded records and rebuild archive index
numerical_duplicates: drop exact Q/K duplicates within/across train, validation and comparison in that order; no label-based filtering

recovery_gate.signal: unchanged observed-coordinate coverage; not a claim of semantic novelty

coverage_frontier: known omitted cells never nominate an unexplored frontier; coverage still adds no traversable payload
